From 8e556432477e97ad6179c61b61a32bf5f1af2355 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Mathias Krause <minipli@grsecurity.net>
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2024 23:07:53 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] eventfs: Use SRCU for freeing eventfs_inodes

To mirror the SRCU lock held in eventfs_iterate() when iterating over
eventfs inodes, use call_srcu() to free them too.

This was accidentally(?) degraded to RCU in commit 43aa6f97c2d0
("eventfs: Get rid of dentry pointers without refcounts").

Cc: Ajay Kaher <ajay.kaher@broadcom.com>
Cc: Masami Hiramatsu <mhiramat@kernel.org>
Cc: Mathieu Desnoyers <mathieu.desnoyers@efficios.com>
Cc: Linus Torvalds <torvalds@linux-foundation.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/20240723210755.8970-1-minipli@grsecurity.net
Fixes: 43aa6f97c2d0 ("eventfs: Get rid of dentry pointers without refcounts")
Signed-off-by: Mathias Krause <minipli@grsecurity.net>
Signed-off-by: Steven Rostedt (Google) <rostedt@goodmis.org>

diff --git a/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c b/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
index a9c28a1d5dc8..01e99e98457d 100644
--- a/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
+++ b/fs/tracefs/event_inode.c
@@ -112,7 +112,7 @@ static void release_ei(struct kref *ref)
 			entry->release(entry->name, ei->data);
 	}
 
-	call_rcu(&ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);
+	call_srcu(&eventfs_srcu, &ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);
 }
 
 static inline void put_ei(struct eventfs_inode *ei)
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `fs/tracefs/event_inode.c`**
   - The function `release_ei` was modified to change the method of freeing `eventfs_inodes`. 
   - The line `call_rcu(&ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);` was replaced with `call_srcu(&eventfs_srcu, &ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);`. 
   - This change updates the synchronization mechanism from RCU (Read-Copy-Update) to SRCU (Sleepable RCU), which is more appropriate for the context of freeing inodes while holding the SRCU lock during iteration.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification in `event_inode.c` directly addresses a regression introduced in a previous commit (43aa6f97c2d0) that mistakenly changed the locking mechanism from SRCU to RCU. 
- By reverting to the use of `call_srcu`, the patch ensures that the freeing of `eventfs_inodes` is properly synchronized with the ongoing iterations over these inodes, thus maintaining the integrity and correctness of the eventfs subsystem. 
- This change is crucial for preventing potential race conditions and ensuring that resources are managed safely in a concurrent environment.

 static void release_ei(struct kref *ref)
 {
 	struct eventfs_inode *ei = container_of(ref, struct eventfs_inode, kref);
 	const struct eventfs_entry *entry;
 
 	WARN_ON_ONCE(!ei->is_freed);
 
 	for (int i = 0; i < ei->nr_entries; i++) {
 		entry = &ei->entries[i];
 		if (entry->release)
 			entry->release(entry->name, ei->data);
 	}
 
-	call_rcu(&ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);
+	call_srcu(&eventfs_srcu, &ei->rcu, free_ei_rcu);
 }
